name: Burn Shard
body:
Price 8,000 gp (lesser), 32,000 gp (greater); Aura moderate transmutation; CL 8th; Slot none; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This small sliver of crystal is completely translucent, although when attuned it flickers with a weak glow. A creature must attune themselves to a burn shard over 24 hours to use it. After a burn shard has been attuned, once per day it can accept 1 point of burn in place of its owner (although it suffers no ill effects from burn). A greater burn shard can instead accept 2 points of burn per day. A creature can only attune themselves to one burn shard at a time.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 4,000 gp (lesser), 16,000 gp (greater); Feats Craft Wondrous Item, kineticist 8th
